name: Medicine (MBBS)
tagline: The hardest door to open in Pakistan.

salaryRange.note: Indicative; varies by specialty, city and sector

description: 5 years + house job. Prestige is real, but so is the 12+ year path to specialization and rising competition for FCPS/USMLE/PLAB.

dayInLife.title: You're a house officer at 7 AM.
dayInLife.scenario: A patient's vitals drop during rounds. What's your move?

options.label: Call the registrar immediately
options.result: Correct. Medicine is knowing when to escalate — you'll do this hundreds of times.
options.insight: Decision-making under pressure, not just memorizing books.

options.label: Manage it alone to prove yourself
options.result: This is how errors happen. You learn hierarchy exists for patient safety.
options.insight: Ego is dangerous in clinical work.

options.label: Document everything first
options.result: Good instinct, but emergencies beat paperwork. You'll balance both daily.
options.insight: You'll spend ~40% of time on documentation.

realityCheck: Top public colleges close at 91–96% aggregate. Below 90% FSc? Plan a parallel path.

name: Pharmacy (Pharm-D)

salaryRange.note: Community, hospital, industry and regulatory tracks

whyNow.value: 5-year clinical doctorate in a steady pharma sector

description: A clinical doctorate opening community, hospital, industrial and regulatory careers — with pharma among Pakistan's steadiest employers.

dayInLife.title: You're a hospital pharmacist.
dayInLife.scenario: A doctor prescribes two drugs with a known interaction.

options.label: Flag it and suggest an alternative
options.result: Exactly your job — you just prevented a serious reaction.
options.insight: Pharmacists are the safety net between prescription and patient.

options.label: Dispense as written
options.result: The patient reacts badly and it traces back to you.
options.insight: Clinical knowledge is a real responsibility.

realityCheck: Pharm-D is a 5-year doctorate, not a backup diploma — it rivals MBBS in scope.

name: Physiotherapy (DPT)
tagline: Rehab is a booming, under-served field.

salaryRange.note: Clinical, sports, neuro and home-health tracks

description: A 5-year clinical doctorate focused on movement. Demand is rising in sports medicine, neuro-rehab and geriatric care — with real global mobility.

dayInLife.title: A post-surgery knee patient walks in.
dayInLife.scenario: They're frustrated and want to skip rehab.

options.label: Show the long-term cost of skipping
options.result: They commit. Six weeks later they walk normally.
options.insight: Half your job is motivation and education.

options.label: Just give exercises and move on
options.result: They drop out and lose range of motion.

realityCheck: DPT needs an entry test in most provinces but with far more seats than MBBS.

name: Biotechnology & Bioinformatics

salaryRange.note: Research, pharma, health-tech and remote global roles

whyNow.value: Bioinformatics skills are in global shortage

description: Where biology meets computation. Pre-med students who add coding unlock biotech, genomics and health-tech careers — many fully remote and global.

dayInLife.title: You're analyzing genome data.
dayInLife.scenario: A dataset has 1 million rows and a tight deadline.

options.label: Write a script to automate it
options.result: You finish in hours, not weeks. This is why bioinformaticians get paid.
options.insight: Coding multiplies what a biologist can do 100x.

options.label: Manually go through the data
options.result: Impossible at this scale. You learn automation is not optional.
options.insight: Scale forces you to think in code.

realityCheck: Pre-med students who learn Python are rare — that scarcity is your advantage.

name: Dentistry (BDS)
tagline: Clinical prestige with better work-life balance.

whyNow.value: ~1,200 BDS seats but less competition than MBBS

description: 4 years + house job. Similar prestige to MBBS with a faster path to independent private practice and steadier hours.

dayInLife.title: A patient arrives with severe tooth pain.

options.label: Reassure and explain each step
options.result: They relax, you complete the procedure smoothly.
options.insight: Chair-side manner is half the skill.

options.label: Proceed quickly to save time
options.result: They tense up and the appointment goes sideways.
options.insight: Trust is built before the drill.

realityCheck: BDS closing merits run 4–6 points below MBBS — a realistic medical-adjacent target.

name: Health Technology

salaryRange.note: Product, PM and founder roles in health startups

whyNow.value: Digital health is a fast-growing global market

description: Combine clinical empathy with product/tech skills to build or run digital health products — telemedicine, health apps, hospital systems.

dayInLife.title: You're building a telemedicine app.
dayInLife.scenario: A rural clinic needs a feature you didn't plan for.

options.label: Talk to the doctors first
options.result: You discover the real need and build the right thing.
options.insight: Domain empathy is your edge over pure engineers.

options.label: Ship what was planned
options.result: The feature misses the mark and adoption stalls.
options.insight: In health, talking to users is non-negotiable.

realityCheck: Rare hybrid profile — few people understand both medicine and product.
